name: print-social-periwinkle-tips-post-with-slanted-label-blocks-and-hands
title: Tips cover with slanted blue label blocks, greyscale hands with phones and halftone lips
whatItIs: A grainy periwinkle 4:5 post with a big blue square holding a cream numeral '3', slanted blue label blocks with cream caps for the title, two greyscale hands holding phones, two halftone lips, and a white note card with an orange top edge and warning badge.
whatItMeans: Clear and modern-collage; label blocks feel like cut-out tape.
techniques: Set each line of the headline on a slanted colour block.
Use a giant numeral in a square as the entry point.
Add greyscale halftone cut-outs as collage elements.
Use a white note card with a coloured top border for the key message.

vocabulary.definition: A photo rendered in dots and cut out.
A large number in a coloured square.
A white card highlighting a key message.
